Frequently Asked Questions
Is the M4 meta in Warzone?
The M4 is currently ranked as Meta in Warzone. Its current pick rate is 0.3%, which shows how popular the weapon is compared to other options.
What is the best M4 Loadout?
The best M4 Loadout is the
Sniper Support
build. For the attachment you want to use:
ZLR Type C
Optic,
XRK Mil-Tac Suppressor
Muzzle,
Hurricane Grip
Underbarrel,
Hurricane Stock
Stock,
SA Laz-500
Laser,
M4 Hurricane
Apex.
Is the M4 easy to use?
The M4 has a base EaseScore of 6.2/10. Easescore is a proprietary metric to evaluate how easy a gun is to use. The higher it is, the easier the gun is.
What is the M4 TTK or Time To Kill in Warzone?
With the
Sniper Support
loadout, the M4 has a weighted average time to kill of 602ms from 0 to 10m, 725ms from 10 to 40m, 806ms from 40 to 80m and 860ms from 80 to 120m.

.
What is the M4 pick rate?
The current M4 pick rate is 0.3%. Pick rate is a useful indicator of how popular the weapon is in the current Warzone meta, but it should always be compared with its Loadout quality, TTK, recoil control, and overall ranking.
In which Call of Duty games is the M4 meta?
The M4 is currently part of the meta in
Warzone
,
Modern Warfare 4
. Its exact ranking and best builds are listed for each game on this page.
How many attachments are available for the M4?
The M4 can be equipped with 70 different attachments. You can browse them all, with their unlock levels, in the Attachments section above.
How do you unlock camos for the M4?
Every camo for the M4 has its own challenge to complete, spread across 2 camo grinds:
Weapon Camos
,
Weapon Prestige
. You can track your progress for each of them with the CODMunity camo tracker.
Has the M4 been nerfed or buffed recently?
Yes. The M4 has received 3 balance adjustments; the most recent one arrived in Season 1 on 13/11/2026. The full balancing history is listed on this page.
Is the M4 getting more or less popular?
At the start of the tracked period the M4 had a pick rate of 0.13%; it now sits at 8.02%. The daily evolution is charted in the Pick Rate Evolution section above.
